name: Zorawar light tank
protection: Light armour with modular add-on and APS provision. Game: IFV-class hull: immune to small-calibre rounds, 12.7/14.5 mm penetrates side and rear, every launcher penetrates.
visual_notes: K9-derived tracked hull with Cockerill 3105 turret: angular, flat-sided with bustle
Six road wheels per side, high-altitude engine
Built for Ladakh after the 2020 Galwan crisis; 59 ordered, trials 2024-26
